units.source_text: 我思想：难道金阁虚构的美，幻化成别的什么东西了吗？

en.t: I thought: could the imaginary beauty of the Golden Pavilion have transformed into something else?

units.source_text: 美为了保护自身，可能会诓骗人的眼睛。

en.t: Beauty, in order to protect itself, may deceive human eyes.

units.source_text: 我本应更接近金阁，剔除使自己的眼中产生丑陋感觉的那种障碍，检查一个个细微部分，亲眼看看美的核心。

en.t: I should have drawn closer to the Golden Pavilion, removed the obstacle that made my own eyes feel ugliness, examined each tiny detail, and seen the core of beauty with my own eyes.

units.source_text: 既然我只相信眼睛见得着的美，那么采取这种态度是理所当然的。

en.t: Since I believed only in beauty that my eyes could see, it was only natural for me to take such an attitude.
